mapper.select: SELECT q.id FROM quote q WHERE q.deleted = 0 AND q.status = 1 ORDER BY q.id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT q.id AS bizId, q.title AS title, q.content AS content, q.author AS authorName, q.source AS source, NULL AS categoryId, q.poetry_category AS categoryName, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.name ORDER BY t.name SEPARATOR ',') AS tagNamesText, q.status AS status, q.original AS isOriginal FROM quote q LEFT JOIN quote_tag qt ON qt.quote_id = q.id LEFT JOIN tag t ON t.id = qt.tag_id WHERE q.id = #{quoteId} AND q.deleted = 0 GROUP BY q.id, q.title, q.content, q.author, q.source, q.poetry_category, q.status, q.original
